summary: This CSS styles a code snippet viewer with interactive line-by-line annotations. It defines a container for preformatted code, individual line styling with hover effects, and small badge buttons that appear next to each line to trigger tooltip explanations. The tooltips themselves are positioned absolutely with a small arrow pointer and adapt their colors based on light or dark theme.

explanations.4: overflow-x: auto allows horizontal scrolling if a code line is too long to fit, while keeping everything else visible
explanations.5: var(--prism-background-color, #282c34) uses a CSS variable if it exists, but falls back to a dark gray color if not defined
explanations.13: display: flex makes this line container use flexbox layout, which lets us line up code and badges side-by-side
explanations.14: align-items: flex-start aligns the code and badge to the top of the line, rather than centering them vertically
explanations.24: flex: 1 makes the code section expand to fill all available horizontal space, pushing the badge to the right
explanations.25: white-space: pre preserves spaces and line breaks exactly as written, so indentation in code is maintained
explanations.32: flex-shrink: 0 prevents this placeholder from shrinking smaller than its natural width, keeping it as a consistent spacer
explanations.38: display: inline-flex is like flex but treats the element as inline, letting it sit alongside text naturally
explanations.50: border-radius: 50% with equal width and height creates a perfect circle for the badge
explanations.59: transition smooths color and background changes over 0.15 seconds when hovering, for a polished feel
explanations.65: .eli5_badge_active is a class you'd add with JavaScript to make the badge appear active without needing hover
explanations.75: top: calc(100% + 5px) positions the tooltip 5 pixels below the badge, using the badge's height as a reference
explanations.78: max-width: 90vw ensures the tooltip never takes up more than 90% of the viewport width, so it stays visible even near screen edges
explanations.89: pointer-events: none makes the tooltip ignore mouse clicks and hovers, so it doesn't interfere with clicking things behind it
explanations.92: .eli5_tooltip::before creates a small decorative arrow pointer using the ::before pseudo-element
explanations.102: transform: rotate(45deg) rotates a small square 45 degrees to make it look like a diamond pointing upward
